articles.body: I understand that you must exhaust armies in regions where there are unrest to defend the attack. However, what about regions where there are no armies (Punjab, Delhi, Mysore, Maratha, Hyderabad)? Do their unrest cubes just add to those associated with the home base of the army - like if Bengal's army attacked Maratha to open up a governor there? So there will only ever essentially be "attacks" against the 3 armies, even if unrest cubes are in other regions?

articles.body: Company-controlled regions are associated to one of the three presidencies. If one of those regions is attacked, the army of the presidency defends it. When you successfully deploy and control a region, you place the token in that presidency to point out that THAT region is associated to THAT presidency, so you can easily identify which army defends which region.
